summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with a generated OpenAPI Swift client). Wrote 18 permanent tests: OpenAPIDocumentTests (10 Foundation-only tests guarding the vendored openapi.json; runtime-red because the document is not vendored yet) and GeneratedClientTests (8 tests driving the future generated ColorMatchingAPI client through a stub ClientTransport; compile-red because the generated target does not exist yet). Recorded the full prose-contract vs published-spec delta analysis (13 findings incl. 3 endpoint gaps) in docs/openapi-generated-client.md as source material for the implementation PR description. Swift toolchain is not available in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; the suite runs on the repo's macOS CI (swift test + xcodebuild). Implementation (Package.swift plugin wiring, vendored spec, model replacement) intentionally deferred to the implementation run per phase rules.
